judge.voice: It was fun that it talked about Roblox and YouTube, and the tasks were easy to understand. I did all of it on my phone and it said A2, which feels right. I liked the part where it showed 'built' instead of 'build'. But the TV showing my mistake, 'we build spaceship', as my words was a bit embarrassing, and the long sentence about a harder task falling short I did not really read. It also said 'not yet' for my spaceship answer and then said I gave an idea and a reason, which is confusing. I would use it again for ten minutes after school, but I want more praise first.
